name: B10-0406/2026 – Recital D – Am 56
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the recent hybrid attacks and instrumentalisation of migrants in Ceuta and the need for a coordinated response to protect the EU’s external borders
part_text: D. whereas it is estimated that approximately 10 000 migrants remain in Ceuta, of whom over 2 000 are unaccompanied minors, 20 % of which are girls; whereas many people still have no access to shelters despite the opening of 4 500 new emergency reception places for adults and families, which, according to the Spanish authorities, will soon be increased to over 6 000 places, with a further 2 000 places for unaccompanied minors;
